# Tool library file

<!-- Generated by `chipload reference`; do not edit. Regenerate with CHIPLOAD_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 cargo test -p chipload-cli --test guide. -->

Your tool library (`tools.json` in the settings folder) and the files `tool export` writes. Lengths in mm, angles in radians, feeds in mm/min.

Schema version 2. Older files load through Chipload's migrations; this schema describes only the current version.

## The file

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `default_tool` | string or null | no | The tool a new project starts with. |
| `schema_version` | `2` | yes |  |
| `tools` | list of [LibraryTool](#librarytool) | yes |  |
| `written_by` | string or null | no |  |

## Cutting

Values filled into an operation when it is created with this tool. Never applied to an existing operation.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `feed` | number | yes |  |
| `plunge_feed` | number | yes |  |
| `step_down` | number | yes |  |
| `stepover` | number | yes | Fraction of the tool diameter, 0 < stepover <= 1 (pockets). |

## LibraryTool

One tool of the library: a project tool with a name and optional cutting values.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `angle` | number or null | no | V-bits: included angle, radians; None = unknown. |
| `center_cutting` | boolean or null | no |  |
| `cutting` | [Cutting](#cutting) or null | no |  |
| `diameter` | number | yes |  |
| `flutes` | integer or null | no |  |
| `id` | integer | yes | The id it gets in a project when that id is free there. |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `rpm` | number or null | no |  |
| `tip_diameter` | number or null | no | V-bits: flat tip diameter, mm; None = pointed. |
| `type` | [ToolType](#tooltype) | no |  |

## ToolType

One of: `"endmill"`, `"drill"`, `"vbit"`.
